reverse: What are the advantages of using Reverse Factoring?

Invoices are paid to suppliers faster. Better
                              prices for full payment upfront and more supplier
                              options in companies that could previously not
                              accept long payment terms. Happy suppliers =
                              better business relationships.

If you usually take (for example) 30 days to pay a
                              supplier, we can help you pay him from day 1.
                              After your usual 30 days term passes, you pay us
                              back plus a fee.
